title: Forth Drafts and Fragments
description: Unfinished programs, experiments, and small tools from the 1982 MMSFORTH disks.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: Conquest (blocks 45-51)
versions.note: Space strategy game in progress. No start word; some characters are stored as z, j, and p.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.

versions.label: Decoder by Rich Losey (blocks 55-55)
versions.note: ROT-13 decoder by Rich Losey, initialed RWL and dated Nov 11, 1982. The Forth System disk holds a slightly different form.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:

 0 ( NOV 11,1982     DECODER PAGE 1 OF 1       RWL     )
 1 
 2 : TASK ;
 3 
 4 : LODE      PAGE  CR ." IS STRINGS LOADED IN " Y/N
 5          IF CR  ." PUT IN SYSTEM DISK " ENTER STRINGS
 6    CR ." PUT IN PROGRAMS DISK " ENTER THEN ;
 7 
 8 : FIGURE    KEY DUP DUP 28 = IF CR DROP ELSE DUP 64 > IF

versions.label: Digit Recording (blocks 65-66)
versions.note: Samples the cassette port into an array and plays it back. Needs PSE, defined only in the authors’ compiled system.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
==== Block 65 ====
 0 ( DIGIT RECORDING )
 1  2000 ARRAY RECORD
 2   CODE :DI DI NEXT    CODE :EI EI  NEXT
 3 : REC ( I RANGE - I+1 RANGE )  DUP ROT 1+ 2000 MOD DUP
 4   ROT  ( RA I+ I+ RA ) SWAP RECORD ! SWAP  ;
 5 
 6 : RANGE ( I RANGE VAL - I RANGE )  255 = 2* 1- OVER * 0> IF
 7   DUP 0> IF 1+ ELSE 1- THEN   ELSE  REC  0< 2* 1- THEN ;
 8 (
 9 : GRAPH < XPOS VAL  - XPOS+1 > 255 = SWAP 1+ 127 MOD SWAP
10              IF DUP 14 SWAP ESET DUP 9 SWAP ECLR ELSE

versions.label: Logging (blocks 21-24)
versions.note: An unfinished screen-logging routine in Pascal-like pseudocode and Forth.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
==== Block 21 ====
 0 (LOGGING)
 1 (  PROCEDURE PRINT - INPUT CHAR ;
 2      ADD TO BOTTOM OF SCREEN
 3      IF LF OR CR
 4        THEN
 5          HOLD LINE
 6          REPLACE HOLD
 7          ADD LINE TO LOG
 8        END    END )
 9 :PRINT EMIT
10      END'SCREEN  C@ 0 = NOT IF

attribution.text: From my 1982 MMSFORTH disks. The Decoder is by Rich Losey, who initialed it RWL. My friend and roommate Rich Losey may have contributed to the others here. Preserved here for small-scale archival use.
